# OpenAI Node SDK Releases — captured 2026-06-02

## Latest Releases (June 2026 - April 2026)

**v6.41.0** (June 1, 2026)
- Add Amazon Bedrock Responses support. (NEW)

**v6.40.0** (June 1, 2026)
- Workload identity in audit logs
- Additional_tools item in responses
- Made ActionSearch.query optional

**v6.39.1** (May 28, 2026)
- Bug fixes only (no new features)

**v6.39.0** (May 21, 2026)
- Multiple API updates and manual enhancements

**v6.38.0** (May 15, 2026)
- Added `service_tier` parameter to responses compact method

**v6.37.0** (May 7, 2026)
- New `quantity` field in admin organization usage responses
- Added `web_search_call.results` output option to responses
- Launched realtime translate and image 2 updates
- Fixed imagegen `size` enum regression
- API key headers now redacted in debug logs

**v6.36.0** (May 1, 2026)
- Group type and user metadata fields across admin resources
- Admin API Keys support per endpoint

**v6.35.0** (April 28, 2026)
- WebSocket binary message support
- Path parameter support in WebSocket clients
- Message queuing during connection establishment
- Browser WebSocket support with simple auth
- Automatic reconnection for WebSockets
